title: 事故分级与响应式规格

branches.label: 编制实施规格
branches.query: Plan spec-first implementation of a guided incident severity wizard with a review checkpoint, testable acceptance criteria, incremental implementation stages and atomic changes.

branches.label: 定义事故分级
branches.query: Define SEV1 through SEV5 using downtime, data loss, blast radius and business impact. Specify SLAs, escalation chains, communications and criteria to raise or lower severity.

branches.label: 设计跨设备布局
branches.query: Design responsive wizard and incident cards for phones, tablets and war-room TVs. Use breakpoints, container queries, fluid type and accessible mobile touch targets.
